inputs.shares_source: 52,801,964 common shares outstanding August 3, 2026 (10-Q Q2 2026 cover page)
inputs.fcf_source: Mid-cycle normalized owner cash: four-year average operating cash flow $535M less sustaining mining capital spending ~$105M = ~$430M; base case uses $230M (FY2025 filing OCF $229M) as trough anchor scaled to mid-cycle $230M owner cash / 52.8M shares ≈ $4.35/sh for Lawrence path — not peak 2022 OCF $842M
inputs.production_source: Steelmaking coal production 9.3 million metric tons in 2025 (10-K FY2025 Item 1)
inputs.cash_source: Cash, cash equivalents and restricted cash $310.4M at June 30, 2026 (10-Q Q2 2026; sec_companyfacts)
inputs.debt_source: Long-term debt noncurrent $154.6M at June 30, 2026 (10-Q Q2 2026)
inputs.liquidity_source: Available liquidity ~$483.9M including cash, short-term investments, and ABL availability (10-K FY2025 liquidity disclosure)
inputs.normalization_note: FY2025 was a trough year: net income $57M, operating income $46M, operating cash flow $229M on met coal price weakness. Lawrence base owner cash uses trough-to-midcycle normalization ($230M base owner cash), not 2022 peak OCF $842M. Q2 2026 rebound (revenue $504M, net income $87M, diluted EPS $1.65) supports recovery but is not yet four-quarter run-rate.

component_valuation.coverage_statement: Met coal mining operations, net cash, Blue Creek development option, and explicit cycle reserve — each valued once.

components.label: Alabama met coal longwall operations at mid-cycle utilization

valuation.evidence: FY2022-FY2025 operating cash flow $842M/$701M/$367M/$229M; FY2025 production 9.3M metric tons; longwall mines No. 4 and No. 7 (10-K FY2025)
valuation.assumption_summary: Mid-cycle owner cash $230M base × capital-cycle multiple / 52.8M shares; trough FY2025 anchor, not peak 2022.
valuation.falsifier: Met coal prices stay below cash cost for four quarters and FY owner cash falls below $150M.

source.locator: Cover page; 52,801,964 common shares outstanding August 3, 2026

assumptions.label: Mid-cycle normalized owner cash after sustaining capital
assumptions.rationale: Base between FY2025 trough OCF $229M and four-year average less sustaining capex; low assumes prolonged weak pricing; high assumes partial reversion toward 2024 economics.

assumptions.label: Capital-cycle owner-cash capitalization multiple
assumptions.rationale: Through-cycle multiple on normalized owner cash for a low-cost longwall producer; not peak-margin capitalization.

calculations.label: Equity value of met coal operations

valuation.evidence: Cash $310.4M less long-term debt $154.6M at June 30, 2026 / 52.8M shares (10-Q Q2 2026)

assumptions.label: Operating liquidity retained above distributable net cash
assumptions.rationale: Low case haircuts surplus cash needed for Blue Creek development and working capital.

components.label: Blue Creek second longwall development option

valuation.evidence: Blue Creek longwall development disclosed in 10-K Item 1; company optimizing first longwall before second; federal coal lease renewals filed January 2026 (8-K 2026-01-16)
valuation.assumption_summary: Risk-weighted incremental capacity value net of remaining development spend; zero in Lawrence consolidated FCF path.

assumptions.label: Probability Blue Creek reaches planned second-longwall economics
assumptions.rationale: Development underway but timing and capital intensity uncertain; base reflects partial completion risk.

assumptions.label: Gross success value to equity
assumptions.rationale: Incremental NPV of additional longwall capacity at mid-cycle met coal margins; not replacement-cost capitalization.

assumptions.label: Remaining owner-funded development cost
assumptions.rationale: Mining asset capex and pre-production spend before second longwall reaches steady state.

components.label: Met coal supply-response and price-normalization reserve

valuation.evidence: Capital-cycle failure mode: peak margins capitalized; global met coal supply can respond when prices recover (10-K risk factors; Power Zone capital_cycle profile)
valuation.assumption_summary: Explicit deduction for cyclical price mean reversion and supply response not captured in trough-normalized owner cash.

assumptions.label: Cycle reserve as fraction of price
assumptions.rationale: Low case assumes market embeds unsustainable mid-cycle optimism; base reflects moderate supply-response risk.
